title: I built a multiplayer hide and seek game for my kids using Claude. Now my coworkers won't stop playing it.
author: Sudden_Network621
selftext:
My kids and I love those hide and seek games where you disguise yourself as random objects. So I thought, why not try building our own?

I used Claude to develop it and Kenney assets for the visuals.

What started as a little experiment for my kids turned into a multiplayer browser game called Mimic Hunt. I showed it to my coworkers, and somehow we ended up playing hide and seek instead of working. 😂

It now works on desktop and mobile, supports solo play and multiplayer with up to 20 players per round. I've attached a gameplay video showing what I've built so far.

One thing I've realized while developing with AI is that getting something playable is becoming much easier. But making it genuinely fun is still the real challenge. I'm currently experimenting with different power-ups and ways to make hiding and seeking more chaotic.

Happy to share the playable build if anyone wants to try it!
